# RastaRoots Life

> RastaRoots is a Manchester herbal tea brand rooted in Caribbean and African heritage, founded by Dion Depeiaza (Rasta Roots Limited). It sells the Founder Box (also called the Discovery Collection): 25 naturally caffeine-free herbal tea sachets across five blends (Roots Fire, Bush Doctor, Empress Bloom, Iron Root and Cool Mind) for £19.99, shipping across the UK. The site also hosts a free Herbal Library of 55 Caribbean and African herbs, plus traditional Caribbean drink recipes.

Health content on this site is educational and is not medical advice. RastaRoots does not claim its teas treat, cure or prevent any condition.

## Shop

- [Founder Box / Discovery Collection](https://shop.rastarootslife.com/products/rastaroots-discovery-collection): 25 sachets, 5 blends, £19.99, in stock

## The five blends

- [Roots Fire](https://www.rastarootslife.com/roots-fire.html): ginger, lemongrass and mint
- [Bush Doctor](https://www.rastarootslife.com/bush-doctor.html)
- [Empress Bloom](https://www.rastarootslife.com/empress-bloom.html): hibiscus, mint and moringa
- [Iron Root](https://www.rastarootslife.com/iron-root.html): sarsaparilla, ginger and moringa
- [Cool Mind](https://www.rastarootslife.com/cool-mind.html): mint, lemongrass and hibiscus
